targets.notes: Custom-built careers page on the company's own domain. Not a third-party ATS. Server-rendered HTML with possible client-side hydration.
Ashby ATS. JavaScript-rendered single-page application - job list and details are injected client-side, so requests need JS rendering or an API interception approach.
Greenhouse ATS job board. More traditional server-rendered markup - jobs are present in the initial HTML response, making it the most straightforward of the three to parse.
